principle: Only promote city/venue/date facts to verified when an official, first-party, government, organizer or reliable public source directly supports them. Editorial visit counts remain separate from verified historical totals.

levels.label: OFFICIAL PRIMARY
levels.meaning: first-party or official source directly supports the displayed venue/date claim

levels.label: VERIFIED
levels.meaning: claim is supported by a reliable cited public source

levels.label: EDITORIAL MODEL
levels.meaning: product/editorial structure; do not read as an official historical total

levels.label: PENDING EVIDENCE
levels.meaning: placeholder or relationship awaiting source-level verification
